title: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation grows first-half sales in 2027 financial year
summary: India: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation reported 11% year-on-year sales growth to US$624m in the first half of India’s 2027 financial year, that started on 1 April 2026, from US$564m previously. title: Conch Investment Holding and Hope Global Investment break ground on 1Mt/yr Malibé cement plant
summary: Gabon: China-based Conch Investment Holding and Hope Global Investment have commenced construction of their upcoming US$195m, 1Mt/yr Malibé cement plant in Estuaire. The La Tribune newspaper has reported that the companies will jointly build, finance and operate the plant. It will serve Gabon’s domestic market when operational.

title: Afrimat publishes six-month 2027 financial year results
summary: South Africa: Afrimat recorded sales of US$309m in the six months up to the end of August 2026, the first half of its 2027 financial year (FY 2027). This corresponds to a year-on-year decline of 4%. Alliance News has reported that the producer attributed the decline to the performance of its cement business, alongside other units. Afrimat's pretax profit fell by 48%, to US$8.36m.
